title: Slow--Fast Response Correction for a Compact Fourth-Order IMEX Two-Derivative Method
summary: A compact two-stage fourth-order two-derivative IMEX method may retain its classical non-commuting fourth-order expansion and L-stable stiff damping while losing high-order accuracy when the relaxation time is comparable with the time step. We ask whether uniform fourth-order accuracy can be recovered without redesigning the original two-stage, two-implicit-solve core.
